items.docs:
Returns a fixed greeting payload. Exists to allow clients to verify
connectivity and credentials. Does not consult any downstream
services.

params.name: category
params.description: Component group to check. Omit for a generic liveness response.

items.docs:
Reports the status of downstream services. With no `category`
parameter, returns a simple "alive" greeting. With
`category=autogenerator` or `category=scim`, reports
per-component status and returns 503 if any required service is
unhealthy.
